QA Automation Engineer – Mobile
In this role, you will:

Design, implement, and execute manual and automated test suites for mobile (iOS, Android) and web applications;
Perform functional, end-to-end, and rebranding testing to ensure consistent and high-quality user experience;
Submit, regress, verify defects, conduct root-cause analysis and track defect resolution to completion;
Review and provide feedback on product specifications, design documents, and test cases.
Collaborate closely with development, design, and product teams to maintain high-quality deliverables;
Explore and leverage AI-assisted testing tools or frameworks to enhance test coverage and efficiency.


You should ideally have:

Strong QA skills – troubleshooting, bug isolation and reporting, and a solid understanding of testing methodologies and processes;
Experience testing across different operating systems: Android, iOS, Windows and macOS;
Familiarity with mobile and web testing frameworks (manual and automated).
Basic networking knowledge;
Scripting or automation experience, preferably with Python or Java;
Experience with Agile workflows and issue tracking systems such as Jira;
Ability to create, review, and follow detailed test plans and test cases;
Interest or hands-on experience with AI-based testing or automation tools;
Good command of written and spoken English.
